text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Air Groove going around asking various
horse girls for advice, so I decided to call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to her, she's surveying horse girls who have siblings
on how to make up after a sibling spat.
And Air Groove's next target is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...How do I make up with my sister, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Forgive the abrupt inquiry. Due to personal matters,
I need to gather reference cases.
If you don't mind, I would like to hear your experience.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
.........Nothing special. If I'm wrong, I apologize.
If she's wrong, I accept her apology.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? How strange.
I don't recall ever receiving an honest apology from you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Because I've never been the one in the wrong.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What nonsense. Haven't I always been the one yielding to you?
Out of big-sister kindness, I was the one making concessions.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I was the one doing you a favor by accepting your apology!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Um, I have an older sister and a younger sister...
Making up after a fight, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
My older sister plays pranks on me sometimes, but
it never really escalates into an actual fight, or rather...
I can't bring myself to fight back...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
And my little sister... is so cheerful, and whatever
she tries she does so flawlessly...
so I can't be firm with her either.........

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, someone like me trying to compete
wouldn't even qualify as a fight, I think............
So, um...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you all right? Do not despair so deeply.
You are you. Have more confidence in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
But, compared to those two, someone like me is...
truly............

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If there is anything troubling you, I will listen.
You may come talk to me anytime.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Making up after a sisters' quarrel, is it?
That is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
There is no precedent for that...
I am afraid I cannot be of much help...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Thank you for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There you are! You're looking into sibling
relationships, right?
My elder sister says she simply insists on speaking with you!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, my 'Empress'!!
Hearing that you were troubled, I cut my personal affairs short
to make time for you. Come now, tell me everything."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
N-No need, I have all I require!
Please prioritize your own business!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, though I have gathered data,
there is little consistency...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Should I extract cases applicable to my sister's situation
from the information obtained...? Brian's...
No, Pokke's case seems closer...
choice_data_list: Wouldn't just apologizing and making up work?
Wouldn't just apologizing and making up work?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Simply settling things on the surface
will not yield a fundamental solution.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't want any lingering resentment between my sister and me.
If she continues to hold onto it,
she will find it difficult to approach me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If she were to face hardships in the future, the option
of reaching out to me for help would be severed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Losing even a single option would certainly not
be beneficial to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I assumed she was just getting overly worked up about
a silly sister spat.
To think she had considered it this deeply...
choice_data_list: You really care about your sister that much, don't you?
You really care about your sister that much, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course. She is my sister.
How could I not cherish her deeply!
choice_data_list: Why not just tell her exactly what you said right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Will she truly understand, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I rarely get to see my sisters, though we do stay in touch.
I felt the frequency of contact was appropriate, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What those girls think, what they feel...
Lately, I find myself unable to grasp it at all.
...They grow up so fast.
choice_data_list: Try having faith in that growth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... I see. You're right.
My sisters are growing up fast enough to surprise even me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As their big sister, I should believe in them.
I will try conveying these feelings directly.
